preconditions: Both named checkouts are clean with zero staged, modified, or untracked paths and exactly match their required pre-head/pre-tree/ref posture.
The live remote target equals the exact to_commit and to_tree.
The from_commit is an ancestor of the to_commit.
The attached mirror target path is absent.
The evidence task is idle and will not act concurrently.
The protected checkout and meta checkout are not mutation targets.
required_postconditions: Both named checkouts equal the exact to_commit and to_tree.
The mirror remains attached to the exact target branch; the evidence checkout remains detached.
Both named checkouts have clean index/worktree and zero untracked paths.
The attached mirror target path remains absent.
The live remote still equals the to_commit.
The fixed /usr/local/bin/limactl identity, absent canonical substrate instance, durable host sudo, and sudoers sentinel are read-only reverified unchanged.
The auxiliary preparation task worktree remains byte-clean at its original head/tree.
prohibited_actions: any source edit, stage, commit, push, reset, clean, rebase, merge other than the exact attached-mirror fast-forward, force operation, new branch, tag, or remote mutation
any mutation of the protected checkout, meta checkout, or auxiliary preparation task worktree
any build, installer, code-signing, Lima lifecycle, Keychain, launchd, sudoers, known-hosts, prefix, or official evidence action
any Windows, WSL, ordinary Linux-host, closeout, or successor work
